ui.defeat_sub: The Gray Mist made temporary gains, but young King Teodoro dusted himself off and Biscuit rallied the troops!

dialogues.intro_1: Grandma Zenaide: 'Theodoro, sweetie... I told you not to leave the Mother Crown on the windowsill during breakfast.'
dialogues.intro_2: Theodoro: 'But Grandma, Biscoito wanted to admire his shiny reflection!'
dialogues.intro_3: Grandma Zenaide: 'Well, now Baron Ash got moody because he wasn't invited to the festival and took all 6 Stars into the Mist. Grab your wooden sword and go fetch them.'
dialogues.tutorial_move: Grandma Zenaide: 'Drag the virtual stick to walk. No running in socks across the polished floor.'
dialogues.tutorial_coins: Grandma Zenaide: 'Collect the coins on the grass. They're magnetic... cutting edge tech from our local forge.'
dialogues.tutorial_buy: Grandma Zenaide: 'Stand still on the purchase square until the coins fill it up. Archers don't volunteer for free.'
dialogues.tutorial_defense: Grandma Zenaide: 'Here come the Misty critters with cooking pots on their heads. Keep your archers close and smash that Totem!'
dialogues.boss_world_1: Grandma Zenaide: 'That Valley Totem is billowing smoke all over my freshly hung laundry. Knock it down quickly!'
